policy.append_rule: Every confirmed user-reported AgentRouter failure must add or update one case in this corpus and reference an executable regression test before the fix is merged.

routing_cases.prompt: 研究 AgentRouter 的产品定位、主要竞品和市场机会。
调研目前主流 AI Agent API Marketplace 的商业模式。
研究同类量化策略过去一年的实证表现。
在Reddit上，人们对hyperliquid前端产品的看法
查找最近关于 Agentic Commerce 的公开讨论和行业报告。
查找关于 AI Agent 路由的同行评审论文。
找出 Agent routing 领域引用次数最高的 10 篇论文。
查找 2024 年以后关于 multi-agent orchestration 的 arXiv 论文。
查询作者 Stuart Russell 最近发表的论文及合作作者。
查询英伟达最新股价、成交量和市值。
查询 BTC 当前价格以及加密货币市值排名。
查询 BNB Chain 最近 24 小时交易量最大的 10 个流动性池。
查询 SOL/USDC 在不同 DEX 上的交易对和流动性。
查询 AZTEC 最近 24 小时的 smart-money activity。
查询苹果公司最近提交的 10-K、8-K 和其他 SEC 文件。
查询台北未来七天的气温、降雨概率和风速。
搜索 GitHub 上与 ERC-8004 相关、最近仍在更新的开源项目。
查询最近一周全球媒体如何报道 AI Agent 支付。
检查 example.com 是否被标记为恶意域名或钓鱼网站。
查找台北车站附近目前营业、评分超过 4.3 的咖啡店。
查询下周五从台北飞往东京的直飞航班。
查询快递单号 EZ1000000001 当前运输状态。

阅读这条 X 帖子的内容并总结观点：https://x.com/example/status/1234567890。
使用 OpenAlex 查找 AgentRouter 相关资料。

帮我研究一下这个东西。

bug_regressions.scenario: A paid call without an AgentRouter account connection must open browser approval instead of requesting an API key.
bug_regressions.expected: agentrouter_connect browser handoff

bug_regressions.scenario: 帮我连接 AgentRouter must authorize an existing installation and must never rerun the installer.
bug_regressions.expected: connect when tool visible; reload-only when configured but stale; install only on explicit install intent

bug_regressions.scenario: A missing upstream source credential must open AgentRouter's source authorization page.
bug_regressions.expected: agentrouter_connect_source handoff without requesting a key in chat

bug_regressions.scenario: Generic research language must not force OpenAlex.
bug_regressions.expected: general research uses Exa; scholarly metadata uses OpenAlex

bug_regressions.scenario: solc must not install the vulnerable tmp transitive dependency.
bug_regressions.expected: tmp is overridden to 0.2.7 and solc still compiles

bug_regressions.scenario: The browser approval page must show an unmistakable success state after authorization.
bug_regressions.expected: visible success panel and completion copy

bug_regressions.scenario: API cards emphasize price and trust score and do not render a favorite heart.
bug_regressions.expected: price/trust core metrics; no heart control

bug_regressions.scenario: Switching to BNB Chain must use BSC identity, reputation, validation and explorer configuration.
bug_regressions.expected: chain-specific addresses and no Arc identity reuse

bug_regressions.scenario: Each ERC-8004 feedback submission uses one sponsored zero-gas BSC transaction and never silently charges the consumer.
bug_regressions.expected: pm_isSponsorable then eth_sendRawTransaction; offchain fallback if denied

bug_regressions.scenario: Feedback and evidence anchoring must use the active settlement chain and must not duplicate writes.
bug_regressions.expected: single chain-correct feedback anchor

bug_regressions.scenario: General external-information tasks must try AgentRouter before agent-reach or generic web search.
bug_regressions.expected: AgentRouter first hop with explicit fallback handoff only

bug_regressions.scenario: Successful calls must request and accept consumer feedback, not only failures.
bug_regressions.expected: uniform feedback request on every successful path

bug_regressions.scenario: Every registered API must expose reputation and called-but-unrated services must not appear as never called.
bug_regressions.expected: reputation on every listing surface with separate call and rating counts

bug_regressions.scenario: An unidentified query cannot buy a service because of one shared keyword.
bug_regressions.expected: no paid route without identified intent

bug_regressions.scenario: Top-volume requests must preserve the provider's ranking instead of inventing a local ranking.
bug_regressions.expected: provider ranking and operation retained

bug_regressions.scenario: A chain name such as BSC must not be parsed as the requested token.
bug_regressions.expected: chain and token are extracted independently

bug_regressions.scenario: Routing must apply the owner's actual spending limit and use unambiguous limit keys.
bug_regressions.expected: owner max price enforced before invocation

bug_regressions.scenario: When no service matches, the agent must receive a usable no-match route instead of an invalid paid call.
bug_regressions.expected: no_match or explicit handoff

bug_regressions.scenario: Missing BNB Paymaster configuration must remain an explicit offchain/not-configured state.
bug_regressions.expected: no fabricated gas-free onchain success

bug_regressions.scenario: Local social connectors must not expose browser credentials or silently degrade to generic scraping.
bug_regressions.expected: browser-managed read-only handoff and explicit coverage status

bug_regressions.scenario: When AgentRouter is configured but the current client has not loaded agentrouter_connect, account authorization must still open in the browser without rerunning installation.
bug_regressions.expected: standalone device authorization writes the shared credential and never changes MCP configuration

bug_regressions.scenario: Comparing social-data providers while listing platforms must not trigger a local content search on the first platform name.
bug_regressions.expected: general provider research route with no local social intercept

bug_regressions.scenario: A request that explicitly selects XPOZ or SocialDataX must not be intercepted by the first mentioned local platform or collapse a multi-platform request to one platform.
bug_regressions.expected: named vendor retained, all requested platforms preserved, and missing credentials handed to agentrouter_connect_source

bug_regressions.scenario: Ask and fetch must share explicit-provider priority, and a social result set must not be called sufficient merely because it contains enough unrelated or undated rows.
bug_regressions.expected: entry-point parity plus relevance, timestamp, content-depth, and per-platform evidence diagnostics

bug_regressions.scenario: A transient AgentRouter remote MCP outage must not become a fatal JSON-RPC tool error that encourages an untracked public-web fallback.
bug_regressions.expected: bounded retry for safe transient failures, then a structured retry boundary that preserves AgentRouter as the first hop

bug_regressions.scenario: When AgentRouter returns a free local social alternative, the agent must execute it through agentrouter_request instead of probing OpenCLI from a sandboxed shell or falling back to generic web search.
bug_regressions.expected: explicit MCP handoff contract and distinct local runtime isolation error

bug_regressions.scenario: A local Fake-IP DNS or TUN outage must not prevent AgentRouter MCP initialization, tool discovery, local connector use, account authorization, or safe failover to a healthy production origin.
bug_regressions.expected: network-independent local control plane, bounded dual-origin failover, per-origin circuit recovery, and structured diagnostics

bug_regressions.scenario: Entity-scoped X research for whale.ag must not mix WhaleDance results or silently bypass AgentRouter through agent-reach.
bug_regressions.expected: typed account/search operations, preserved time bounds, strict entity constraints, and agent-reach only through an explicit AgentRouter handoff

bug_regressions.scenario: When Codex or Claude exposes a built-in read-only browser, AgentRouter must prefer it without pretending OpenCLI installation is account authorization.
bug_regressions.expected: capability-negotiated native browser handoff, OpenCLI fallback, and structured completion feedback

bug_regressions.scenario: Local account-history feedback must accept read_user_posts request ids while rejecting fabricated local invocations.
bug_regressions.expected: authenticated server-issued one-time grant bound to request, actor, operation, and service

bug_regressions.scenario: External, local, quote, and ERC-8004 feedback state must survive a server restart.
bug_regressions.expected: all persistent event types hydrate into one canonical memory view

bug_regressions.scenario: A retried feedback submission must not duplicate reputation, while a conflicting replay must be rejected.
bug_regressions.expected: idempotent event key, acknowledged identical replay, and 409 conflict for mutation

bug_regressions.scenario: One routed invocation must produce exactly one operational feedback event and public queries must include external and local feedback.
bug_regressions.expected: canonical global feedback view without compatibility-path duplicates

bug_regressions.scenario: A failed BNB Paymaster submission must not remain indefinitely pending or disappear after restart.
bug_regressions.expected: explicit offchain_recorded, onchain_pending, onchain_submitted, or onchain_failed state

bug_regressions.scenario: A tiny feedback sample must not appear as a mature Trust Score or dominate routing.
bug_regressions.expected: sample confidence, Bayesian-style prior shrinkage, explicit no-feedback state, and completion metrics

bug_regressions.scenario: The published MCP package must not import source files excluded from the npm tarball.
bug_regressions.expected: all relative imports resolve inside a clean installed package

bug_regressions.scenario: Native browser completion must be callable through hosted MCP and HTTP, not only the local stdio bridge.
bug_regressions.expected: one completion protocol across stdio, remote MCP, and HTTP

bug_regressions.scenario: A browser handoff must not allow target mutation, forgery, expiry bypass, or replay.
bug_regressions.expected: signed immutable expiring single-use handoff

bug_regressions.scenario: Native-browser routing must support every social platform parsed by the MCP bridge and common canonical host aliases.
bug_regressions.expected: X, TikTok, YouTube, Bilibili, Reddit, Xiaohongshu, Zhihu, and Weibo canonicalize consistently

bug_regressions.scenario: Caller-returned browser fields must not be described as independently verified content.
bug_regressions.expected: identity matching separated from caller-attested field status and evidence hash

bug_regressions.scenario: A feedback grant hydrated after restart has no recoverable raw token and must not dead-end the user.
bug_regressions.expected: same-actor authenticated token rotation persisted as a new event

bug_regressions.scenario: Local feedback tokens must not remain forever in an unbounded process map.
bug_regressions.expected: bounded TTL cache and deletion after accepted feedback

bug_regressions.scenario: Liveness must not claim the service is ready when persistence or shared handoff signing is unavailable.
bug_regressions.expected: separate readiness endpoint with dependency diagnostics

bug_regressions.scenario: A change must not ship without testing the actual npm tarball as a clean consumer.
bug_regressions.expected: CI tests, audit, dry-run pack, install, and MCP initialize smoke test

bug_regressions.scenario: Agents must not guess whether a built-in browser is callable from an opaque consumer_context object.
bug_regressions.expected: published adapter, availability, operation, and session-mode schema plus structured fallback

bug_regressions.scenario: The exact task 查XLM当前最大爆仓痛点 must preserve XLM in both the core structured router and natural-language compatibility route.
bug_regressions.expected: perpetual liquidation max-pain for XLM with realtime assumption and no asset clarification

bug_regressions.scenario: When a paid AgentRouter route needs account authorization, the user must actually see the browser approval page rather than only receiving hidden action metadata.
bug_regressions.expected: safe automatic browser launch plus a retained clickable URL and headless opt-out

bug_regressions.scenario: The exact task 查XLM当前最大爆仓痛点 must not return only a raw liquidation heatmap or an API description after a successful paid call.
bug_regressions.expected: derive and state the maximum-pain price, liquidation side, and current-price comparison while retaining source evidence

bug_regressions.scenario: Hosted MCP recommends agentrouter_connect but does not expose it.
bug_regressions.expected: session-bound browser device authorization with no API key in chat

bug_regressions.scenario: Anonymous free calls require feedback but reject the feedback without an account.
bug_regressions.expected: opaque invocation-bound feedback grant accepted over HTTP and MCP

bug_regressions.scenario: Open-Meteo and GDELT fail in production with an opaque fetch failed result.
bug_regressions.expected: IPv4-first DNS, bounded retry/timeout, scoped queries, and actionable diagnostics

bug_regressions.scenario: Home and Agent Hub have clipped, unrecoverable horizontal overflow on a phone viewport.
bug_regressions.expected: min-width-safe grids, wrapping tables, commands, logos, and pagination

bug_regressions.scenario: An unknown source is reported as an account connection requirement.
bug_regressions.expected: 422 unsupported_source without an authorization detour

bug_regressions.scenario: Home and public stats show contradictory total call counts with no scope explanation.
bug_regressions.expected: one canonical total_calls metric plus explicit registered-service scope

bug_regressions.scenario: Login and payment pages omit standard browser security response headers.
bug_regressions.expected: CSP, HSTS, nosniff, referrer policy, permissions policy, and frame denial

bug_regressions.scenario: Provider failures are transported as HTTP 200 and become invisible to basic monitoring.
bug_regressions.expected: 422/429/502 status mapping while preserving structured tool payloads

bug_regressions.scenario: Malformed JSON becomes a 500 and leaks the parser message.
bug_regressions.expected: 400 INVALID_JSON with a stable public message

bug_regressions.scenario: HEAD home and browser CORS preflight are rejected.
bug_regressions.expected: HEAD parity and bounded OPTIONS response

bug_regressions.scenario: Connector failures expose only fetch failed with no stage or retry guidance.
bug_regressions.expected: stage, category, trace, upstream status/code, timeout, attempts, and retryability

bug_regressions.scenario: A high trust score appears beside zero evidence without explaining the different inputs.
bug_regressions.expected: visible trust basis, sample counts, evidence coverage, and factual-accuracy caveat

bug_regressions.scenario: Public stats returns a large uncached service/event payload with unnecessary operational detail.
bug_regressions.expected: cached compact service summaries and detail endpoint separation

bug_regressions.scenario: The clean package smoke can hang silently during pack or install.
bug_regressions.expected: bounded subprocess time and visible phase progress

bug_regressions.scenario: Hosted MCP reports 0.1.0 while the published client is 0.13.1.
bug_regressions.expected: server version sourced from the published MCP package manifest

bug_regressions.scenario: Research login and source connection actions collapse into vertical text on mobile.
bug_regressions.expected: one home brand link and a non-shrinking compact action group

bug_regressions.scenario: Agent Hub search repeats slow catalog work and gives no explanation for weak description-only matches.
bug_regressions.expected: bounded response time and visible match reason

bug_regressions.scenario: Submitting an empty research question focuses a field without explaining the error.
bug_regressions.expected: inline accessible required-field message

bug_regressions.scenario: GDELT production calls fail when HTTPS hangs, Jina is unreachable, or the query contains unsupported two-character keywords such as AI.
bug_regressions.expected: normalize known short terms and use HTTPS, direct HTTP, then proxy as bounded transport fallbacks

bug_regressions.scenario: Feedback for virtual external API services cannot prepare a BNB Chain ERC-8004 transaction because no Vendor registry manifest supplies an agent id.
bug_regressions.expected: resolve an explicit chain-specific Vendor identity and never inherit the AgentRouter Platform ID

bug_regressions.scenario: The external connector platform identity has no safe browser-wallet registration path, and the existing server registration is pinned to Arc testnet.
bug_regressions.expected: operator-only BSC wallet registration, authoritative transaction verification, durable identity hydration, and automatic feedback use without exposing a private key

bug_regressions.scenario: Third-party Vendor feedback is written to one shared AgentRouter Platform Agent ID, contaminating reputation across unrelated data suppliers.
bug_regressions.expected: each Vendor registration mints one chain-generated Agent ID, shares it across that Vendor's services, persists it, and keeps feedback isolated from the Platform ID

bug_regressions.scenario: A Vendor registering its isolated ERC-8004 identity is asked to pay BNB gas from its browser wallet.
bug_regressions.expected: the Vendor signs an exact zero-gas registration, AgentRouter sponsors it through the BNB Paymaster, Vendor remains the transaction sender and owner, and sponsorship failure never falls back to Vendor-paid gas

bug_regressions.scenario: An AgentRouter account login boundary is mislabeled as connecting an upstream API/data source, causing repeated or incorrect credential prompts.
bug_regressions.expected: account login always outranks source metadata, and source OAuth, API credentials, local browser sessions, and no-auth access use distinct machine-readable states and user-facing actions

bug_regressions.scenario: A normal Render restart or multi-instance request loses the signed-in browser session and interrupts an OAuth callback because both states exist only in process memory.
bug_regressions.expected: encrypted authenticated browser sessions and OAuth state survive restart with a shared secret, while tampered, expired, or wrong-secret tokens fail closed

bug_regressions.scenario: A composite Hyperliquid wallet-profit leaderboard request is reduced to wallet_profile because it contains the generic word address, so the agent asks for payment before discovering that no matching capability exists.
bug_regressions.expected: classify the exact leaderboard capability, verify a callable registered service before auth or pricing, and return capability_not_available without requesting user authorization

bug_regressions.scenario: The agent marketplace stays on Loading services because a nested inline Hire handler emits invalid JavaScript, although the services API is healthy.
bug_regressions.expected: all rendered page scripts compile before release; Hire uses a data attribute and a standard click listener
